backend_features.reason: Pinned Rust1.99 softfloat bare-metal aggregate copies omit alternating bytes when SIMD features are enabled (SSE2 at56bytes, AVX at72bytes). Keep the verified built-in integer codegen until a qualified compiler/target correction. Canonical required hardware and full-ISA Zig/C runtime objects are unchanged; direct Rust SIMD is not qualified.

dependencies.sources: explicit local/path or vendored crates only
dependencies.features: Cargo manifest and explicit Features/NoDefaultFeatures arguments

native_c.source: R4MF SOURCE entries after Rust root
native_c.compiler: SDK Profiles/Tools.json tools.zig at an explicit matching installation root

allocation.root_return_cleanup: kernel instance owner after all tasks retire

closed_elf_forms.R_X86_64_GOTPCREL: Final EXEC/DYN only: bound module-owned GOT slot, exact symbol value and -4 addend; emitted as R4M0 REL32 plus ABS64. Nonzero GOT entries must all have definitions. Relaxed GOTPCRELX and ABS32 remain rejected.

native-graphics.origin: R4GL freestanding C/C++ profile and shared runtime headers; GL/Nouveau selection removed. No native-link or device capability claim.

metadata.description: R4OS x86_64 System V userland, SSE2, no red zone, no OS runtime
